question: Which company did Beacon (beaconfounders.com) acquire in August 2026?

hits.title: QXO, Inc. - QXO to Acquire Beacon Roofing Supply for $11 Billion
hits.snippet: QXO, Inc. (NYSE: QXO) and Beacon Roofing Supply, Inc. (Nasdaq: BECN) today announced that they have entered into a definitive merger agreement under which QXO will acquire Beacon for $124.35 per share in cash.

hits.title: QXO Announces Agreement to Acquire Beacon for $11B | Industrial Distribution
hits.snippet: After nearly a century in business — and months of often-contentious negotiations — building materials distributor Beacon will be acquired by newly formed company QXO in a deal worth about $11 billion, company officials announced Thursday.

hits.title: QXO completes $11B purchase of Beacon Roofing Supply - Virginia Business
hits.snippet: Beacon Roofing Supply, a Herndon Fortune 500 roofing material and building supplies company, is now a subsidiary of Connecticut software and tech business QXO after the closing of its $11 billion purchase Tuesday, QXO announced.

hits.title: QXO Acquires Beacon in $11 Billion All-Cash Deal | Roofing Contractor
hits.snippet: It was a slow-moving creep until velocity picked exponentially, and early Thursday morning, it became official: QXO completed its acquisition of Beacon in an all-cash transaction valued at approximately $11 billion.

hits.title: List of 23 Acquisitions by Beacon (Jul 2026) - Tracxn
hits.snippet: Beacon has made 23 acquisitions across sectors such as Building Materials, Construction Contractors, Professional Consumer Services and others. DM Figley, Chicago Metal Supply and Roofers Mart are its latest acquisitions.

hits.title: QXO, Inc. - QXO Completes Acquisition of Beacon Roofing Supply
hits.snippet: (NYSE: QXO) today announced it has completed its previously disclosed acquisition of Beacon Roofing Supply, Inc., for $124.35 per share, valuing the transaction at approximately $11 billion.

hits.title: Who Owns Beacon Company? – MatrixBCG.com
hits.snippet: In anticipation of a potential acquisition, QXO, Inc. put forth a slate of 10 independent director nominees for Beacon's 2025 Annual Meeting of Shareholders. This move was part of QXO's tender offer to acquire Beacon.

hits.title: QXO Acquires Beacon for $11 Billion
hits.snippet: QXO Inc. has acquired Beacon Roofing Supply in an $11 billion cash deal.

hits.snippet: Beacon’s portfolio companies compete in a broad range of segments. One of its most recent acquisitions is PowerUps Sports, which sells a platform that sports clubs use to build websites and manage match schedules.
